hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Each element x can either remain x or be increased to x + 1.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Sort nums so that elements can naturally extend consecutive sequences from smaller values.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Maintain dp[v] as the length of the longest consecutive sequence ending at value v, updating dp[x + 1] before dp[x].

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting nums followed by linear dynamic programming with hash map transitions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exponential subset branching is too slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for sequence length map.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the update ordering dp[x+1] before dp[x] prevents double-counting the current element.
